Fiora.build: Build armor first to withstand the physical damage from Fiora Q Lunge and Fiora E Bladework. If you have to face Fiora for a long time while she sustains through trades, rush Thornmail to apply Grievous Wounds. Armor can’t block the true damage from vitals, and Fiora R Grand Challenge also deals damage based on your maximum health, so don’t rely on stacking only health.
Fiora.combo: Your basic poke is Sion E Roar of the Slayer → Sion Q Decimating Smash. During an engage window after Fiora Q Lunge and Fiora W Riposte are down, activate the shield from Sion W Soul Furnace beforehand, then follow Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught’s collision with Sion Q Decimating Smash → detonate Sion W Soul Furnace → Sion E Roar of the Slayer. During R’s stun, charge Q enough to knock her up so you can land it reliably instead of waiting for a full charge.
Fiora.escape: Right after Fiora Q Lunge is your window to close the gap with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. If Fiora W Riposte is also down, there’s less risk of her blocking the immobilizing effect of Sion Q Decimating Smash, so engage then.
Fiora.fight: Right after you make Fiora use Q Lunge is your chance to close the gap. After confirming Fiora W Riposte is down, slow her with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and hit her with Sion Q Decimating Smash. After a short trade, don’t chase Fiora too far.
Fiora.laning: Early on, prioritize safe farming and stacking maximum health with Sion W Soul Furnace over kills. Stand opposite the vital and limit the direction Fiora can approach from.
Fiora.teamfight: If Fiora uses Fiora R Grand Challenge on Sion, stay by a wall so she can’t reach all four vitals. On the frontline, reduce armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and hold opponents in place with Sion Q Decimating Smash while watching Fiora W Riposte’s timing. Start Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught from somewhere the enemy can’t see when your allies can follow up.
Fiora.watch: Fiora W Riposte blocks the immobilizing effects of Sion Q Decimating Smash and Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught, and can stun you after blocking them, so don’t rush your engage while Riposte is available. Watch the direction of the vital from Fiora P Duelist's Dance and stand on the opposite side. If Fiora R Grand Challenge hits you, stay by a wall to block one side with a vital.

DrMundo.fight: After blocking Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw with a minion, slow him with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and hit him with Sion Q Decimating Smash. Dr. Mundo can walk out of Sion Q Decimating Smash, so in lane, charge it until the knock-up becomes available, then release it. Don’t spend time trying to kill him while Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active.
DrMundo.build: Build armor first to withstand the physical damage from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper deal magic damage, so armor can’t block them. If the duel drags on, consider Grievous Wounds after building resistances.
DrMundo.combo: If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is available, first remove it with the immobilizing effect of Sion Q Decimating Smash, then engage with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. Once his passive is down, activate Sion W Soul Furnace beforehand, then use Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught’s collision → Sion Q Decimating Smash → detonate Sion W Soul Furnace → Sion E Roar of the Slayer. During R’s stun, don’t try to fully charge Q; charge it only long enough to knock him up so you can land it reliably.
DrMundo.escape: Dr. Mundo has no ability to create distance on his own, so the window to engage with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught is after Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down. Block Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw with minions as you approach, and don’t force a kill while Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active.
DrMundo.laning: Early on, prioritize safe farming and stacking maximum health with Sion W Soul Furnace over kills. Push minions toward Dr. Mundo and hit him with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, and dodge Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw from behind minions. After a trade, step on the canister Dr. Mundo drops as you retreat to deny his healing and passive cooldown reduction.
DrMundo.phase: In the mid and late game, take the frontline role with your stacked maximum health and defensive items.
DrMundo.teamfight: Choose a straight path from fog of war or behind a wall within range for your allies to follow, then engage with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is available, it may block the key immobilizing effects of Sion Q Decimating Smash or R, so consider a sequence that removes his passive first. On the frontline, reduce armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and hold enemies in place with Sion Q Decimating Smash and Sion W Soul Furnace to protect your damage dealers.
DrMundo.watch: Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw only hits the first target it reaches and deals more damage the higher your current health is. Dodge it with minions between you, and don’t take long trades while taking empowered basic attacks from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. When Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active, his healing and movement speed increase, so don’t insist on getting the kill.

Aatrox.teamfight: Start Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught from fog of war along a straight path, within range for your allies to follow up. On the frontline, reduce Aatrox’s armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, and hold enemies in place with Sion Q Decimating Smash and Sion W Soul Furnace to protect your damage dealers. Consider where you might go down so Sion P Glory in Death lets you fight once more near an objective.
Aatrox.combo: Your basic poke is to slow with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then charge Sion Q Decimating Smash. If Aatrox E Umbral Dash is down, engage with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught, then charge Sion Q Decimating Smash enough to knock him up after the collision stun. Activate Sion W Soul Furnace just before engaging, detonate it once enemies are clustered, and finish with Sion E Roar of the Slayer.
Aatrox.laning: Early on, focus on farming safely and stacking maximum health with Sion W Soul Furnace rather than looking for kills. Push minions toward Aatrox with Sion E Roar of the Slayer to poke, and use Sion Q Decimating Smash when you have a chance to hit it. If you avoid giving up early kills, the matchup gets easier as the game goes on.
Aatrox.phase: Sion has little pressure early, and Aatrox can snowball an advantage easily, so it’s important not to give up kills. Sion gets stronger in the mid and late game when the maximum health stacked with Sion W Soul Furnace combines with defensive items.
Aatrox.build: Build armor first to reduce the physical damage from Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains. If healing is prolonging fights, rush Thornmail so you can apply Grievous Wounds reliably on the frontline. Use Sion E Roar of the Slayer to reduce Aatrox’s armor before fighting.
Aatrox.escape: Right after you bait out Aatrox E Umbral Dash is your window to close the gap with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains catches you, don’t rush your engage; leave its area first to avoid being pulled back in.
Aatrox.fight: Look to trade right after Aatrox uses the empowered basic attack from Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance on a minion. After Aatrox uses Aatrox E Umbral Dash, slow him with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and look for a chance to hit Sion Q Decimating Smash. Don’t continue dueling while Aatrox R World Ender is active.
Aatrox.watch: Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade is dangerous at the tip, so when you see the cast animation, dodge outside its outer edge or move in close. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains hits you, walk out of its area immediately so you aren’t pulled back in.

Malphite.watch: Malphite R Unstoppable Force is an unstoppable dash, so Sion Q Decimating Smash can’t interrupt it. When you don’t know Malphite’s position, don’t stand close to your allies, and don’t start a trade while slowed right after Malphite Q Seismic Shard hits you.
Malphite.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Malphite Q Seismic Shard, E Ground Slam, and R Unstoppable Force. Consider Spirit Visage as a defensive item, since it also benefits Sion W Soul Furnace’s shield.
Malphite.combo: In lane, slow and reduce armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then charge Q Decimating Smash and land it. If the enemy isn’t locked down, charge Q Decimating Smash only long enough to land the knock-up, then release it.
Malphite.escape: The moment Malphite R Unstoppable Force goes down is your chance to engage. Malphite has no other mobility spell at that point, so close the gap with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught and hit him with Q Decimating Smash.
Malphite.fight: Break Malphite P Granite Shield first, then start trading to chip away at his actual health. Avoid trading immediately after Malphite Q Seismic Shard slows you.
Malphite.laning: Early on, safely last-hit to stack maximum health with Sion W Soul Furnace. Push a minion toward Malphite with Sion E Roar of the Slayer to poke him, then keep attacking after breaking Malphite P Granite Shield. Malphite Q Seismic Shard can’t be dodged from behind minions, so don’t stay within its range for long.
Malphite.phase: Early on, while Malphite R Unstoppable Force is unavailable, Sion has a chance to farm and gain lane control. In the mid-to-late game, use the maximum health stacked with Sion W Soul Furnace and your defensive items to play the frontline in teamfights.
Malphite.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Malphite R Unstoppable Force can’t knock up several of you at once, and don’t give him an opening to engage when his position is unknown. Once that R is down, counterattack by reducing armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and locking enemies down with Q Decimating Smash. Start Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught from out of vision when your allies can follow, and guard the space in front of your damage dealers with Sion W Soul Furnace’s shield.

Mordekaiser.escape: The window after Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp misses is your chance to engage with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. Mordekaiser has no ability to create distance on his own, so after catching him, follow with Sion Q Decimating Smash. If Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is available, though, avoid engaging where your allies can’t help you.
Mordekaiser.build: Mordekaiser’s main abilities deal magic damage, so build magic resistance first and consider Spirit Visage as a defensive item. Spirit Visage also helps Sion W Soul Furnace’s shield and the life steal during Sion P Glory in Death. His basic attacks hurt too, so you also need armor; avoid relying only on health because Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise deals damage based on your maximum health.
Mordekaiser.combo: For your basic poke, slow Mordekaiser with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then hit him with Sion Q Decimating Smash. Before engaging, activate Sion W Soul Furnace, then collide with him using Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught and charge Sion Q Decimating Smash only long enough to land the knock-up before releasing it. Once enemies are grouped, detonate Sion W Soul Furnace and follow with Sion E Roar of the Slayer.
Mordekaiser.fight: In lane, keep trades short—just one or two hits—and back off before Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates. Slow him with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then charge Sion Q Decimating Smash only long enough to land the knock-up. Right after Mordekaiser W Indestructible’s shield activates, don’t unload your damage; look for an opening after the shield has worn down or been converted into healing.
Mordekaiser.laning: Early on, prioritize safe farming and stacking maximum health with Sion W Soul Furnace over going for kills. Push minions with Sion E Roar of the Slayer to poke Mordekaiser, and use Sion Q Decimating Smash when the slow gives you an opening to land it. Keep your distance so Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp can’t pull you into an extended fight.
Mordekaiser.phase: Sion’s early pressure is weak, and extended fights that activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise are dangerous, so focus on farming. In the mid-to-late game, use the maximum health stacked with Sion W Soul Furnace and your defensive items to play the frontline.
Mordekaiser.teamfight: Start Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught from out of vision when your allies can follow. On the frontline, reduce armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and lock down enemies with Sion Q Decimating Smash and Sion W Soul Furnace. Spread out so Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp can’t pull several of you in at once, and avoid positions where you’ll be isolated while Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is available.
Mordekaiser.watch: If Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp pulls you in, you’re likely to take Mordekaiser Q Obliterate and basic attacks as well, so keep your distance and dodge it head-on. Once Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise is active, staying close costs you more the longer you remain there, so back away. While Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is available, don’t go in alone where your allies can’t help you.

Darius.combo: Before engaging, activate Sion W Soul Furnace, collide with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught, then charge Sion Q Decimating Smash enough to knock them airborne and hit them.
Darius.escape: Look for an opening when Darius E Apprehend misses or is on cooldown. After Darius R Noxian Guillotine is down, close the gap with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught and follow with Sion Q Decimating Smash. Save your answer to Darius E Apprehend until then.
Darius.build: Build armor first to withstand Darius’s main damage, and get Thornmail earlier if Darius sustains through fights with the healing from Darius Q Decimate. Darius E Apprehend ignores some armor, and Darius R Noxian Guillotine deals true damage, so stacking maximum health with Sion W Soul Furnace is also important.
Darius.fight: Only take short trades after Darius E Apprehend misses or is down. Create distance before Darius P Hemorrhage stacks up.
Darius.laning: Early on, prioritize safe farming and stacking maximum health with Sion W Soul Furnace over kills. Avoid long trades and early skirmishes.
Darius.phase: Sion has little pressure early, and Darius is strong in skirmishes, so farm safely. In the mid and late game, focus on the frontline role, where the maximum health stacked through Sion W Soul Furnace combines with your defensive items.
Darius.teamfight: Start Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught from fog of war when your allies can follow up. Be careful not to become the start of a chain of kills by being executed by Darius R Noxian Guillotine while Darius P Hemorrhage is stacked on you.
Darius.watch: If Darius E Apprehend pulls you in, he can follow with a basic attack, Darius W Crippling Strike, and Darius Q Decimate, so poke from outside its range. If Darius P Hemorrhage stacks up, create distance to drop the stacks. When you see Darius Q Decimate, dodge outside the blade’s range or move close to reduce his healing. If health has decreased while bleed stacks remain, get completely out of range of Darius R Noxian Guillotine, which deals true damage.

Kayle.build: Since Kayle’s damage is mostly magic, switch your defensive item toward Spirit Visage and build magic resistance. Spirit Visage also helps with the shield from Sion W Soul Furnace and the life steal during Sion P Glory in Death. Prioritize dodging a direct hit from Kayle Q Radiant Blast, since it reduces your resistances.
Kayle.combo: For basic trades, slow Kayle with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then hit her with Sion Q Decimating Smash. Before engaging, activate Sion W Soul Furnace’s shield; after the stun from Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught’s collision, charge Sion Q Decimating Smash enough to knock her airborne and hit her. Then detonate Sion W Soul Furnace and use Sion E Roar of the Slayer, but delay your damage during the damage immunity from Kayle R Divine Judgment.
Kayle.escape: Kayle has no mobility spell, so engage by applying crowd control before she can use Kayle W Celestial Blessing to gain movement speed and escape. Look for a chance to close the gap with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught after dodging the slow from Kayle Q Radiant Blast or after she uses Kayle W Celestial Blessing. Once you engage, lock her down with Sion Q Decimating Smash.
Kayle.fight: Commit to the fight once Kayle R Divine Judgment is down.
Kayle.laning: Use Sion E Roar of the Slayer to push minions toward Kayle and poke her, and charge Sion Q Decimating Smash when you can land it.
Kayle.teamfight: When your allies can follow up, start Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught from out of sight and take a path that reaches Kayle in the back line. If Kayle R Divine Judgment activates, hold her with the crowd control from Sion Q Decimating Smash or Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught, then attack after the damage immunity ends. On the front line, reduce armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, lock down opponents with Sion Q Decimating Smash, and protect your allied damage dealers.
Kayle.watch: Dodge a direct hit from Kayle Q Radiant Blast, which slows and reduces armor and magic resistance. When you have lost health, watch out for Kayle E Starfire Spellblade, which deals damage based on your missing health. While Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, don’t pour on damage; stall with the crowd control from Sion Q Decimating Smash or Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught.

Akali.build: Build magic resistance first to withstand Akali’s damage. Consider Spirit Visage as a defensive item. It also benefits Sion W Soul Furnace’s shield and your lifesteal during your revival.
Akali.combo: Your basic poke is Sion E Roar of the Slayer → Sion Q Decimating Smash. Before engaging, activate Sion W Soul Furnace, then follow Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught’s collision with Sion Q Decimating Smash → detonate Sion W Soul Furnace → Sion E Roar of the Slayer. During Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught’s stun, charge Sion Q Decimating Smash enough to knock Akali up so you can land it reliably.
Akali.escape: Your window to engage is before Akali R Perfect Execution comes back up. If only one of Akali W Twilight Shroud or Akali E Shuriken Flip is down, she still has another way to move, so don’t rush your engage. When an opening appears, close the gap with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught and follow with Sion Q Decimating Smash.
Akali.fight: Slow with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then hit Sion Q Decimating Smash.
Akali.laning: Prioritize safe farming and stacking maximum health with Sion W Soul Furnace over kills. Akali has low armor, so look for chances to build a health and CS lead during windows when the ultimate is unavailable.
Akali.phase: In the mid and late game, take the frontline role with the maximum health stacked through Sion W Soul Furnace and your defensive items.
Akali.teamfight: Start Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught from fog or behind a wall when your allies can follow up. Fight where you can block for your damage dealers, and after you go down, Sion P Glory in Death can buy time for your allies to escape.
Akali.watch: Once marked, the second dash follows Sion as he runs away.

Aurora.build: Prioritize Spirit Visage as a defensive item to build magic resistance. Aurora’s main damage is magic, and Spirit Visage also helps Sion W Soul Furnace’s shield. Aurora P Spirit Abjuration deals damage based on your maximum health, so don’t rely on building only health.
Aurora.combo: Your basic poke is Sion E Roar of the Slayer → Sion Q Decimating Smash. Before engaging, activate Sion W Soul Furnace, then collide with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught and charge Sion Q Decimating Smash enough to knock Aurora up so you can land it. Then detonate Sion W Soul Furnace and use Sion E Roar of the Slayer.
Aurora.escape: Your window to engage is after Aurora has used both Aurora W Across the Veil and Aurora E The Weirding. If only one of her mobility abilities is down, she can escape with the other.
Aurora.fight: Engage after Aurora E The Weirding and Aurora W Across the Veil are down. First slow her and reduce her armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then hit her with Sion Q Decimating Smash. Aurora has relatively low armor, so this is a good chance to deal physical damage with Sion.
Aurora.laning: Early on, prioritize safe farming and stacking maximum health with Sion W Soul Furnace over kills. Push minions toward Aurora with Sion E Roar of the Slayer to poke, and don’t charge Sion Q Decimating Smash for long while Aurora still has a mobility ability available. If health has decreased after a trade, retreat and watch for the recall damage from Aurora Q Twofold Hex.
Aurora.phase: Bait out Aurora’s mobility ability and fight when you can go back in. In the mid and late game, take the frontline role with the maximum health stacked through Sion W Soul Furnace and your defensive items.
Aurora.teamfight: Start Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught from fog or behind a wall, and make sure your allies are close enough to follow up. On the frontline, reduce armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and hold enemies in place with Sion Q Decimating Smash and Sion W Soul Furnace. If Aurora jumps in but fails to kill anyone, that’s a chance to catch her; when retreating, don’t leave low-health allies behind.
Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again when recalled, and that damage increases with the amount of health lost. If cursed, move out of the line connecting you and Aurora; if you are below half health, retreat before the recall. Move away before Aurora R Between Worlds unfolds, or be ready to fight inside its area.

Camille.build: Build armor first to withstand Camille’s main damage. However, armor won’t reduce the true damage from Camille Q Precision Protocol, and stacking only health increases the damage from Camille W Tactical Sweep. If Camille’s healing lets her sustain through trades, rush Thornmail.
Camille.escape: Even if Camille E Hookshot is down, don’t immediately commit deep if Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum is still available. When both mobility abilities are down, close the gap with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught and follow with Sion Q Decimating Smash.
Camille.fight: Avoid trading right after Camille P Adaptive Defenses activates its shield. Once the shield has been removed and Camille E Hookshot is down, slow her with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and hit her with Sion Q Decimating Smash. If Camille can move, charge Sion Q Decimating Smash only long enough to knock her up.
Camille.laning: Stay away from walls, stand among your minions, and avoid positions where Camille E Hookshot can catch you. Push minions toward Camille with Sion E Roar of the Slayer to poke while safely farming last hits. Early on, prioritize farming and stacking maximum health with Sion W Soul Furnace over kills.
Camille.phase: Camille is weak before her first core item, but Sion also lacks early damage, so farm safely. In the mid and late game, make use of the health stacked through Sion W Soul Furnace and your defensive items, but don’t leave the side lane open for Camille’s fast tower taking.
Camille.teamfight: Engage with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught along a straight path from fog of war when your allies can follow up. On the frontline, reduce armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and hold enemies in place with Sion Q Decimating Smash and Sion W Soul Furnace. Even if you go down, position yourself in front of your damage dealers so you can fight once more with Sion P Glory in Death.
Camille.watch: Camille E Hookshot uses walls to engage from long range and stun you, so stay away from walls. The empowered second attack from Camille Q Precision Protocol includes true damage and is dangerous, so create distance while she prepares it. When Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum starts, don’t waste your counter; fight back after the trapping duration ends.

Chogath.build: Prioritize magic resistance against the magic damage from Cho'Gath Q Rupture, W Feral Scream, and E Vorpal Spikes, and consider Spirit Visage. Spirit Visage also helps Sion W Soul Furnace’s shield. Cho'Gath R Feast deals true damage that resistances can’t block, and stacking only health increases the damage from Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes, which is based on your maximum health.
Chogath.combo: In lane, push minions and hit Cho'Gath with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then charge Sion Q Decimating Smash against the slowed Cho'Gath. Before engaging, activate the shield from Sion W Soul Furnace and collide with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught, then charge Sion Q Decimating Smash enough to knock him up so you can land it. Then detonate Sion W Soul Furnace and use Sion E Roar of the Slayer.
Chogath.escape: Engage right after Cho'Gath uses Q Rupture on the wave or after you dodge its telegraphed area. Cho'Gath has no mobility ability and has a hard time creating distance once caught, so hold him in place with the slow from Sion E Roar of the Slayer and Sion Q Decimating Smash. Approach from the side to avoid the frontal silence from Cho'Gath W Feral Scream.
Chogath.fight: Dodge the warning for Cho'Gath Q Rupture to the side, then slow him with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and hit Sion Q Decimating Smash. Move to avoid the frontal area of Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, and if silenced, focus on walking rather than using abilities. If Cho'Gath can escape, charge Sion Q Decimating Smash only long enough to knock him up.
Chogath.laning: Cho'Gath gets stronger as the game goes on, so early on, use Sion E Roar of the Slayer toward the minions to poke with the minions it pushes back. Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes pierces minions, so stand off the line Cho'Gath faces when he attacks. Rather than forcing a kill, stack maximum health with Sion W Soul Furnace by last hitting, then pressure him with your jungler right after Cho'Gath uses Q Rupture on the wave.
Chogath.phase: Early on, limit Cho'Gath’s time to stack, but prioritize safe farming and stacking maximum health with Sion W Soul Furnace. In the mid and late game, Sion’s stacked health and defensive items come into their own, but Cho'Gath also gets stronger as he stacks, so don’t approach him at health low enough for Cho'Gath R Feast to kill you.
Chogath.teamfight: Start Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught from fog of war when your allies can follow up, and lock down Cho'Gath and the enemy team. On the frontline, reduce armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and protect your damage dealers with the area crowd control from Q Decimating Smash and the explosion from W Soul Furnace. After going down, use Sion P Glory in Death to keep fighting near an objective or buy time for your allies to escape.
Chogath.watch: Cho'Gath Q Rupture knocks you up after a warning appears beneath you, so move to the side immediately when you see the mark. If you’re hit by the frontal silence from Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, you may be unable to cast abilities and then get hit by Q Rupture, so don’t trade from the front. If your health is at or below half, keep your distance from Cho'Gath R Feast, which defensive items can’t block.

Gangplank.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Gangplank Q Parrrley and Gangplank E Powder Keg. If fights drag on because of the healing from Gangplank W Remove Scurvy, get Thornmail earlier. Gangplank P Trial by Fire and Gangplank R Cannon Barrage deal true damage, which resistances can’t block, so keep stacking bonus health with Sion W Soul Furnace too.
Gangplank.combo: For basic poke, knock a minion toward Gangplank with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then follow with Sion Q Decimating Smash. Before engaging, activate Sion W Soul Furnace’s shield, then collide with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught and charge Sion Q Decimating Smash just long enough to get the knockup and land it. Follow with Sion W Soul Furnace’s explosion and Sion E Roar of the Slayer.
Gangplank.escape: Gangplank has no ability to create distance on his own, so engage just after he places Gangplank E Powder Keg or immediately after you dodge it. If Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down, catch him with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught and follow with Sion Q Decimating Smash.
Gangplank.fight: Trade when Gangplank E Powder Keg has just been placed and isn’t primed yet. Hit a minion with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and knock it toward Gangplank to slow him, then charge Sion Q Decimating Smash just long enough to get the knockup and land it. If Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is still available, time your key crowd control carefully.
Gangplank.laning: Early on, safely last-hit while weathering Gangplank Q Parrrley and stack bonus health with Sion W Soul Furnace. Look for Sion E Roar of the Slayer poke through minions, but back away if a primed Gangplank E Powder Keg is nearby. Focus on CS and Turret Plating rather than forcing a kill.
Gangplank.phase: Early on, Sion should focus on safe farming and stacking maximum health with Sion W Soul Furnace rather than chasing kills. In the mid to late game, use that stacked maximum health and your defensive items to serve as the frontline.
Gangplank.teamfight: When your allies can follow up, start Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught from out of vision on a straight path and engage the enemy backline. Reduce their armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then pin them down with Sion Q Decimating Smash’s area-of-effect crowd control and Sion W Soul Furnace’s explosion. Watch for overlapping Gangplank E Powder Kegs and the landing area of Gangplank R Cannon Barrage while protecting your damage dealers.
Gangplank.watch: If Gangplank E Powder Keg is primed, back away to avoid the explosion and slow. When a keg is newly placed, stay outside its blast radius and destroy it yourself. Don’t step where two kegs overlap. Check whether Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is available, since it cleanses the crowd control from Sion Q Decimating Smash and Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught.

Garen.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Garen Q Decisive Strike and Garen E Judgment. If Garen P Perseverance lets him sustain through the lane, get Thornmail earlier to keep applying Grievous Wounds. Garen R Demacian Justice deals true damage that armor can’t reduce, so build health as well.
Garen.combo: For basic poke, use Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then Q Decimating Smash. If Garen W Courage has just activated, delay Q by half a beat. Before engaging, activate Sion W Soul Furnace, then collide with R Unstoppable Onslaught, charge Q Decimating Smash just long enough to get the knockup and land it, and follow with E Roar of the Slayer.
Garen.escape: Garen has no mobility, so the window to engage is after the empowered attack from Garen Q Decisive Strike has been used. If Garen W Courage has just activated, wait for its shield and tenacity to wear off before using Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught or Q Decimating Smash.
Garen.fight: Trade briefly just after Garen uses Q Decisive Strike’s empowered basic attack on a minion or otherwise expends it. Apply a slow and armor reduction with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then land Q Decimating Smash. Don’t take extended fights inside Garen E Judgment. If Garen W Courage is active, wait a moment instead of using Q right away.
Garen.phase: However, Garen W Courage’s stacks can also build permanently, making him harder to deal with as the game goes on, so hinder his scaling early.
Garen.teamfight: As the frontline, reduce armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and pin enemies down with Sion Q Decimating Smash’s area stun and Sion W Soul Furnace’s explosion. Start Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught from out of vision when your allies can follow up, and don’t rush the collision or Q right after Garen W Courage activates. Protect your damage dealers, but stay out of Garen R Demacian Justice’s range if you’re low enough to be executed.
Garen.watch: Garen Q Decisive Strike empowers his next basic attack and silences, so don’t stand your ground charging Sion Q Decimating Smash while he has it ready. Avoid staying in Garen E Judgment for long; trade briefly and get out. After Garen W Courage activates, it grants a shield and tenacity, so delay Sion Q Decimating Smash and Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught by half a beat. If you’re below half health, watch out for Garen R Demacian Justice, which deals true damage based on your missing health, and stay out of its range.

Gnar.build: Build armor first against Gnar’s main physical damage. Gnar W Hyper / Wallop deals magic damage based on your maximum health, so don’t rely on stacking health alone. If there’s a high risk of being stunned against a wall by Gnar R GNAR!, consider tenacity as a priority too.
Gnar.combo: For basic poke, knock a minion toward Gnar with Sion E Roar of the Slayer to slow him, then use Sion Q Decimating Smash. Before engaging, activate Sion W Soul Furnace and follow this order: stun with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught’s collision → Sion Q Decimating Smash → Sion W Soul Furnace explosion → Sion E Roar of the Slayer. After R, don’t get greedy for a fully charged Q; charge only long enough to get the knockup and land it reliably.
Gnar.escape: Just after Gnar E Hop / Crunch is used is a chance to close the distance with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. Mega Gnar also can’t transform again for a while just after returning to Mini, so look to engage then. On the other hand, delay your engage if Mega Gnar’s transformation is close or you’re lined up to be knocked into a wall by Gnar R GNAR!.
Gnar.fight: Don’t recklessly take Mini Gnar’s ranged poke. Watch Gnar’s Rage bar and whether Gnar E Hop / Crunch is available before fighting. Close the distance just after Gnar uses E or transforms from Mega back to Mini, then slow him with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and land Sion Q Decimating Smash.
Gnar.laning: Early on, prioritize safe farming and stacking bonus health with Sion W Soul Furnace over chasing kills. Poke Gnar by knocking minions back with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, and use Sion Q Decimating Smash when Gnar is slowed or pinned down. If it’s hard to reach Mini Gnar, farm near your turret and wait for his transformation cycle.
Gnar.phase: Early on, Sion has little pressure, so endure Mini Gnar’s ranged poke and focus on CS and stacking maximum health with Sion W Soul Furnace. In the mid to late game, serve as the frontline with your accumulated maximum health and defensive items, and start fights just after Mega Gnar returns to Mini.
Gnar.teamfight: Watch Gnar’s Rage bar and start teamfights just after he returns from Mega to Mini. Don’t stand with your back to a wall or group in narrow terrain where Gnar R GNAR! can stun you. When your allies can follow up, engage with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught from out of vision. Reduce armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then pin enemies down with Sion Q Decimating Smash and Sion W Soul Furnace.
Gnar.watch: Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss slows. Mini Gnar’s boomerang can hit you on the way back, so move out of its path. Back away when Mega Gnar approaches, and don’t stand with your back to a wall where Gnar R GNAR! can stun you by knocking you into it.

Gwen.build: Build magic resistance first against Gwen’s main damage, and get armor too against the physical damage from her basic attacks. If magic damage is concentrated, choose Spirit Visage to enhance Sion W Soul Furnace’s shield and the life steal during Sion P Glory in Death. The true damage in the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! cannot be blocked with resistances, so avoid it through positioning.
Gwen.combo: For basic poke, slow Gwen with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then charge Sion Q Decimating Smash and land it. Before engaging, activate Sion W Soul Furnace. After the stun from Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught’s collision, charge Sion Q Decimating Smash just long enough to get the knockup and interrupt her. Then detonate Sion W Soul Furnace while its shield is still active and land Sion E Roar of the Slayer.
Gwen.escape: The window to engage opens just after Gwen has been made to use Gwen E Skip 'n Slash. In areas with many minions, Gwen E Skip 'n Slash can come back quickly, so draw her into an area without minions or be ready to use the crowd control from Sion Q Decimating Smash as you go in.
Gwen.fight: Just after Gwen uses Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is a chance to close the distance. Slow her with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and land Sion Q Decimating Smash, or engage with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. Avoid the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! as you fight, and don’t take extended trades within range for her to keep basic attacking.
Gwen.laning: Safely last-hit to stack bonus health with Sion W Soul Furnace. Poke Gwen by knocking minions toward her with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, and use Sion Q Decimating Smash when you can pin down her movement. Trade briefly before Gwen’s Q stacks build up, but keep your distance once they’re full.
Gwen.phase: Early on, Sion has little pressure, so focus on safe farming and stacking bonus health with Sion W Soul Furnace. You can look for short trades before Gwen’s Q stacks build up.
Gwen.teamfight: When your allies can follow up, start Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught from out of vision. As the frontline, reduce armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and pin enemies down with Sion Q Decimating Smash. Detonate Sion W Soul Furnace, which you activated beforehand, once enemies are grouped. Avoid the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!, and fight from a position that blocks the way in front of your damage dealers.
Gwen.watch: Move sideways to dodge the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!, which deals true damage. Gwen P A Thousand Cuts and Gwen R Needlework deal damage based on your maximum health, so don’t rely on health alone in extended fights. When Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, you can’t target Gwen from outside the mist, so enter it or wait until it ends.

Illaoi.build: Illaoi’s main damage is physical, and Illaoi W Harsh Lesson deals damage based on your maximum health, so build armor first. If she sustains through fights with healing, get Thornmail earlier to apply Grievous Wounds.
Illaoi.combo: For basic poke, hit Illaoi with Sion E Roar of the Slayer through a minion, then follow with Sion Q Decimating Smash. If you engage just after Illaoi W Harsh Lesson is used, activate Sion W Soul Furnace’s shield first, then follow this order: stun with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught’s collision → Sion Q Decimating Smash → Sion W Soul Furnace explosion → Sion E Roar of the Slayer.
Illaoi.escape: The window to engage opens just after you dodge Illaoi E Test of Spirit and make her use Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. Close the distance with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught, then catch her with Sion Q Decimating Smash.
Illaoi.fight: After dodging Illaoi E Test of Spirit, if she has also used Illaoi W Harsh Lesson, you have a chance to close the distance. Slow her with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then charge Sion Q Decimating Smash just long enough to get the knockup and land it reliably.
Illaoi.laning: Keep the wave away from walls and last-hit from outside Illaoi E Test of Spirit’s range. Poke by knocking minions toward her with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, and stack bonus health with Sion W Soul Furnace from units you kill. Early on, prioritize safe farming over kills.
Illaoi.phase: Early on, Sion has little pressure, so focus on farming and stacking maximum health without fighting near tentacles. In the mid to late game, your accumulated maximum health and defensive items make you tankier, but avoid tentacle areas where Illaoi R Leap of Faith is active.
Illaoi.teamfight: Destroy the tentacles or draw Illaoi into open ground away from walls, and don’t group up against Illaoi R Leap of Faith. When your allies can follow up, engage with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught from out of vision. As the frontline, reduce armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and pin enemies down with Sion Q Decimating Smash and Sion W Soul Furnace.
Illaoi.watch: Illaoi E Test of Spirit slows and marks you, so last-hit from outside its range and dodge it. Illaoi R Leap of Faith is powerful against grouped enemies, so spread out when she uses it and wait for its duration to end.

Irelia.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Irelia Q Bladesurge and Irelia W Defiant Dance. Also consider effects that reduce attack speed to counter the basic attacks empowered by Irelia P Ionian Fervor.
Irelia.combo: For basic poke, slow Irelia with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then land Sion Q Decimating Smash. Before engaging, activate Sion W Soul Furnace’s shield, then after Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught’s collision, charge Sion Q Decimating Smash just long enough to get the knockup and interrupt her.
Irelia.escape: The chance to engage comes just after Irelia uses Q Bladesurge. If Irelia E Flawless Duet’s stun is also down, close the distance with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught and look for Sion Q Decimating Smash.
Irelia.fight: Close the distance immediately after Irelia Q Bladesurge becomes unavailable. If Irelia E Flawless Duet’s stun is also down, look for a chance to slow her with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and land Sion Q Decimating Smash.
Irelia.laning: Early on, prioritize safe last-hitting and stacking bonus health with Sion W Soul Furnace over forcing kills. Don’t leave low-health minions between you and Irelia, and poke by knocking minions toward her with Sion E Roar of the Slayer.
Irelia.teamfight: Irelia R Vanguard's Edge and Irelia E Flawless Duet have a major impact in teamfights, so prioritize Irelia. When your allies can follow up, engage with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught from out of vision. Reduce armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then pin her down with Sion Q Decimating Smash.
Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain dashes through low-health minions to close in on you, so back away when minions are about to die. Watch out for the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet, and if you’re trapped by Irelia R Vanguard's Edge, wait until the blades disappear.

Jax.build: Jax relies on basic attacks and attack speed for his damage, so consider defensive items that reduce attack speed first. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so build both resistances. Jax E Counter Strike deals damage based on your maximum health, so don’t rely on stacking health alone.
Jax.combo: In lane, slow the enemy with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then charge Sion Q Decimating Smash and land it. Before engaging, activate Sion W Soul Furnace’s shield, then after Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught’s collision stun, charge Sion Q Decimating Smash just long enough to get the knockup and interrupt him.
Jax.escape: Don’t use Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught just because you see Jax start to activate Jax E Counter Strike. Engage during the window after Jax E Counter Strike ends and Jax Q Leap Strike is also down. Close the distance with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught, then pin him down with Sion Q Decimating Smash.
Jax.fight: While Jax E Counter Strike is active, stop basic attacking and move out of its stun range. After Counter Strike ends, slow Jax with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and land Sion Q Decimating Smash. If Jax Q Leap Strike is also down, that’s a chance to close the distance with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught.
Jax.laning: Jax has the advantage in melee trades at level 1, so don’t recklessly get close. After that, poke by knocking minions toward him with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, and safely last-hit to stack bonus health with Sion W Soul Furnace. Pressure him with your jungler while Jax E Counter Strike is down.
Jax.phase: In the mid to late game, serve as the frontline with the maximum health you’ve stacked using Sion W Soul Furnace and your defensive items.
Jax.teamfight: If Jax activates Jax E Counter Strike and jumps in, don’t group nearby; layer your crowd control right after the area stun ends. As the frontline, reduce armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and pin enemies down with Sion Q Decimating Smash. Start Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught from out of the enemy’s vision when your allies can follow up.
Jax.watch: When Jax E Counter Strike is active, stop basic attacking and move outside its stun range. Jax can reactivate E Counter Strike after closing the distance with Jax Q Leap Strike, so keep checking the distance needed to land Sion Q Decimating Smash until the stun ends.

Jayce.build: Build magic resistance first, considering the magic damage from Jayce W Lightning Field and Jayce E Thundering Blow. Magic resistance can’t block the physical damage from Jayce Q Shock Blast, and Jayce E Thundering Blow deals damage based on your maximum health. Also consider movement speed so you can leave telegraphed attack areas.
Jayce.combo: In lane, slow the enemy with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then land Sion Q Decimating Smash. Before engaging, activate Sion W Soul Furnace’s shield, then collide with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught and charge Sion Q Decimating Smash just long enough to get the knockup and interrupt him.
Jayce.escape: The chance to engage comes just after Jayce uses the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies!. Close the distance with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught and land Sion Q Decimating Smash. Against Jayce with his hammer out, also account for the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow.
Jayce.fight: Don’t recklessly trade back against Jayce’s early poke; farm while enduring it with Sion W Soul Furnace’s shield. If Jayce Q To the Skies!’s leap is down, slow him with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and land Sion Q Decimating Smash. When you need to close the distance to Jayce, use that opening to engage with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught.
Jayce.laning: Against Jayce with his cannon out, move side to side to dodge Jayce Q Shock Blast flying in a straight line. Knock a minion toward Jayce with Sion E Roar of the Slayer to hit him, and charge Sion Q Decimating Smash while he’s slowed. Early on, prioritize safe farming and stacking maximum health with Sion W Soul Furnace over kills; if health has been chipped away, clear the wave and then head back.
Jayce.phase: Jayce is strong early, so Sion should farm defensively and avoid falling far behind. In the mid to late game, Sion becomes stronger with the maximum health stacked using Sion W Soul Furnace and defensive items.
Jayce.teamfight: Look for the moment Jayce Q To the Skies!’s leap is down, and when your allies can follow up, engage with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught from out of vision. As the frontline, reduce armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and pin enemies down with Sion Q Decimating Smash and Sion W Soul Furnace’s explosion. Protect your damage dealers, and even after you fall, use Sion P Glory in Death to buy your allies time to retreat or continue fighting around an objective.
Jayce.watch: When you see Jayce E Acceleration Gate, step sideways out of the straight line of Jayce Q Shock Blast. When Jayce has his hammer out, watch for the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! and the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow. It’s best to dodge the first basic attack after he switches weapons, since it reduces resistances.

Kennen.build: Prioritize tenacity to deal with Kennen’s damage and build magic resistance. Consider Spirit Visage as a defensive item; it also helps Sion W Soul Furnace’s shield and the life steal during Sion P Glory in Death.
Kennen.combo: In lane, use a minion to land Sion E Roar of the Slayer → Sion Q Decimating Smash. When engaging after Kennen E Lightning Rush is down, activate Sion W Soul Furnace first, then chain Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught’s collision stun → Sion Q Decimating Smash → Sion E Roar of the Slayer. Charge Sion Q Decimating Smash only long enough to guarantee the knock-up lands.
Kennen.escape: The moment Kennen E Lightning Rush goes down is your chance to engage. If Kennen P Mark of the Storm has stacked twice, don’t go in; back off briefly until the stacks disappear, then close the gap with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught.
Kennen.fight: Close the gap and fight after Kennen E Lightning Rush is down. Push a minion with Sion E Roar of the Slayer to hit Kennen, then follow with Sion Q Decimating Smash while he’s slowed. If Kennen P Mark of the Storm has stacked twice, back off first.
Kennen.laning: Early on, focus on safe last hits and stacking maximum health with Sion W Soul Furnace rather than going for kills. Block Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken from behind minions, and step forward only briefly to last-hit. Push a minion toward Kennen with Sion E Roar of the Slayer to poke him, and use Sion Q Decimating Smash when you have a clear angle to land it.
Kennen.phase: Early on, Sion should focus on farming and stacking maximum health with few deaths rather than pressuring for kills. In the mid-to-late game, use your accumulated health and defensive items to play the frontline.
Kennen.teamfight: Don’t stand grouped with your allies, so Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom can’t stun several of you at once, and use vision to deny Kennen an opening to engage. Start Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught from out of vision along a straight path when your allies can follow. On the frontline, reduce armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, lock down enemies with Sion Q Decimating Smash, and absorb Kennen’s engage with Sion W Soul Furnace’s shield.
Kennen.watch: Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken hits only the first target, so stand behind minions. If Kennen P Mark of the Storm has stacked twice, the next hit can stun you, so back off briefly and wait for the stacks to disappear. When Kennen engages with Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom, spread out from your allies to avoid a group stun.

Kled.build: Build armor first because Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, W Violent Tendencies, and E Jousting deal mostly physical damage. Kled W Violent Tendencies and R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! deal damage based on your maximum health, so don’t rely on building health alone. If you’re repeatedly caught in crowd control, consider tenacity; reducing his attack speed gives you more time to avoid Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth attack.
Kled.combo: For your basic poke, use Sion E Roar of the Slayer → Sion Q Decimating Smash. To engage, activate Sion W Soul Furnace first, then chain Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught’s collision → Sion Q Decimating Smash → Sion W Soul Furnace detonation → Sion E Roar of the Slayer. After the stun from Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught, charge Sion Q Decimating Smash only long enough to land the knock-up instead of trying to fully charge it.
Kled.escape: Don’t engage just because Kled E Jousting is down; check whether Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is unavailable too. The window before Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! comes back is especially good for closing the gap with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught and following with Sion Q Decimating Smash. If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope catches you, focus on breaking free before the pull triggers.
Kled.fight: Slow Kled and reduce his armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then hit him with Sion Q Decimating Smash. If Kled E Jousting is still available, he can escape while you charge, so after his mobility is down, charge only long enough to guarantee the knock-up. Before engaging, activate Sion W Soul Furnace for its shield.
Kled.laning: Early on, prioritize safe farming and stacking maximum health with Sion W Soul Furnace over going for kills. Hit a minion with Sion E Roar of the Slayer to push it toward Kled and poke him; avoid extended trades while Kled W Violent Tendencies is active. If you’ve dismounted Kled from Skaarl, watch his Courage bar and, if you can’t finish him right away, create distance to prevent the actions he needs to remount.
Kled.phase: Kled’s early skirmishes are threatening, so safe farming is important for Sion. In the mid-to-late game, the health stacked with Sion W Soul Furnace and Sion’s armor become powerful; avoid giving up an early advantage and extend the game.
Kled.teamfight: Keep vision to see Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! coming from the flank, and if it’s hard to stop, stand in front to protect your backline’s formation. Start Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught from out of vision when your allies can follow. After engaging, reduce armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and lock down enemies with Sion Q Decimating Smash and Sion W Soul Furnace.
Kled.watch: Kled W Violent Tendencies packs its max-health damage into the fourth basic attack, so once the attack sequence starts, create distance before taking all four hits. If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope hits you, break free immediately before it pulls you in. Be cautious about pursuit while Kled E Jousting and Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! are available.

KSante.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from K'Sante P Dauntless Instinct, Q Ntofo Strikes, and W Path Maker. Resistances don’t reduce the true damage from K'Sante W Path Maker, so build health too; if you’re repeatedly caught in crowd control, you can prioritize tenacity. Since K'Sante’s high armor blocks much of Sion’s physical damage, add penetration and reduce his armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer.
KSante.combo: For your basic poke, use Sion E Roar of the Slayer → Sion Q Decimating Smash. Before engaging, activate Sion W Soul Furnace, then chain Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught’s collision stun → Sion Q Decimating Smash → Sion W Soul Furnace detonation → Sion E Roar of the Slayer. After engaging, don’t insist on fully charging Sion Q Decimating Smash; charge it only long enough to guarantee the knock-up lands.
KSante.escape: Don’t engage just because K'Sante W Path Maker is down; check whether K'Sante E Footwork is down too. The window before K'Sante R All Out comes back is especially good for closing the gap with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. If K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes’ pull and stun are ready, first back out of range to avoid them, then engage.
KSante.fight: K'Sante W Path Maker reduces incoming damage and makes him unstoppable while charging, so save Sion Q Decimating Smash. Once K'Sante’s mobility is down, slow him and reduce his armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then hit him with Sion Q Decimating Smash. When K'Sante R All Out is active, focus your damage while his armor is lower, but don’t fight him alone for long because his damage and life steal also increase.
KSante.laning: Hit a minion with Sion E Roar of the Slayer to push it toward K'Sante and poke him, then follow with Sion Q Decimating Smash while he’s slowed. You cannot move while charging Sion Q Decimating Smash, so don’t charge it for long if K'Sante still has mobility available.
KSante.phase: K'Sante becomes harder to lane against as he builds defensive items, while Sion is strongest in the mid-to-late game, when his accumulated health and defensive items come together.
KSante.teamfight: Start Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught from fog or behind a wall when your allies can follow up. On the frontline, reduce K'Sante’s armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then lock him down with Sion Q Decimating Smash after K'Sante finishes charging W Path Maker. Focus him with your team while K'Sante R All Out is active; if the fight will be prolonged, have one teammate bring a source of Grievous Wounds.
KSante.watch: If you’ve been hit by K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes in succession or K'Sante has built stacks on minions, back out of range to avoid the next pull and stun. Don’t stand with terrain behind you, or K'Sante R All Out can knock you over a wall.

Nasus.build: Build armor first against Nasus Q Siphoning Strike, his main source of damage. Nasus E Spirit Fire and R Fury of the Sands deal magic damage, so armor alone won’t stop them; account for R’s damage when considering a build that greatly increases only maximum health.
Nasus.combo: For your basic poke, use Sion E Roar of the Slayer → Sion Q Decimating Smash. Before engaging, activate Sion W Soul Furnace, then collide with the enemy using Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught, charge Sion Q Decimating Smash only long enough to land the knock-up, and follow with W detonation and Sion E Roar of the Slayer.
Nasus.escape: A good time to engage is after Nasus W Wither is down and Nasus R Fury of the Sands has ended. Nasus has no way to create distance other than Flash, so approach with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught and lock him down with Sion Q Decimating Smash.
Nasus.fight: Early on, grow safely while disrupting Nasus Q Siphoning Strike last hits instead of attempting a reckless all-in. Slow him with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then hit him with Sion Q Decimating Smash, and absorb his retaliation with Sion W Soul Furnace’s shield. If Nasus R Fury of the Sands activates, don’t continue fighting; let its duration run out.
Nasus.laning: If you push the lane all the way to Nasus’s turret, he can stack Nasus Q Siphoning Strike easily, so let the wave come toward you and call for a jungle gank. Poke Nasus by pushing a minion into him with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, but use Sion Q Decimating Smash only when you can land it. Last-hitting to stack maximum health with Sion W Soul Furnace is also important.
Nasus.phase: However, Nasus Q Siphoning Strike stacks are permanent, so you’ll fall behind as time passes; limit the opportunities he has to stack from the start.
Nasus.teamfight: Start Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught from somewhere the enemy can’t see when your allies can follow. Keep your distance and let the duration run out rather than facing Nasus head-on while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active.
Nasus.watch: Nasus Q Siphoning Strike becomes more threatening as its stacks grow, so pressure him from the start to deny easy last hits. Nasus E Spirit Fire reduces armor, so leave its area, and avoid fighting while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active unless you have a clear advantage in numbers and damage. If Nasus W Wither catches you alone, it’s difficult to escape, so don’t move within its range by yourself.

Olaf.build: Build armor first to withstand the physical damage from Olaf Q Undertow. Armor doesn’t reduce the true damage from Olaf E Reckless Swing, so build health too; since basic attacks are his main damage source, also consider effects that reduce attack speed.
Olaf.combo: For poke, slow Olaf with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then hit him with Sion Q Decimating Smash. If you engage after Olaf R Ragnarok ends, activate Sion W Soul Furnace’s shield first, then chain Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught’s collision → Q knock-up → E. Detonate W while Olaf is close.
Olaf.escape: Olaf has no ability to create distance on his own, so the moment Olaf R Ragnarok ends is your chance to engage with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. While R is active, don’t try to lock him down with Sion Q Decimating Smash’s crowd control; move behind a wall or your allies and let its duration run out.
Olaf.fight: Early on, avoid extended fights and look for short trades: slow Olaf with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then hit him with Sion Q Decimating Smash. When Olaf R Ragnarok is active, use Sion W Soul Furnace’s shield as you create distance, then apply a knock-up or stun with Q after R ends. Olaf’s attack speed and life steal become stronger as his health decreases, so don’t chase recklessly.
Olaf.laning: Your early goal is safe last hits and stacking maximum health with Sion W Soul Furnace rather than getting kills. Avoid the side where Olaf Q Undertow’s axe lands, push a minion into Olaf with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then charge Q. Olaf can walk out of Sion Q Decimating Smash, so charge only long enough to land the knock-up, then release it.
Olaf.phase: Olaf is strong early, so don’t give him kills; focus on last hits and stacking maximum health with Sion W Soul Furnace. In the mid-to-late game, use your accumulated health and defensive items to play the frontline.
Olaf.teamfight: Engage with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught along a straight path from out of vision when your allies can follow. If Olaf R Ragnarok is active, don’t use crowd control on him; after it ends, reduce his armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and lock him down with Sion Q Decimating Smash. Block access to your damage dealers and use Sion W Soul Furnace’s shield and detonation.
Olaf.watch: Olaf Q Undertow slows you and reduces your armor when it hits, so move opposite the direction where the axe lands to prevent him from retrieving it. When Olaf R Ragnarok is active, your crowd control from Sion Q Decimating Smash and Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught won’t work, so create distance. If Olaf keeps hitting you with basic attacks or Olaf E Reckless Swing, R’s duration is extended; E’s true damage can’t be reduced by armor.

Ornn.build: Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and Ornn E Searing Charge deal physical damage, while Ornn W Bellows Breath and Ornn R Call of the Forge God deal magic damage, so build both armor and magic resistance. If crowd control often leaves you unable to act before you die, consider tenacity before resistances. Ornn W Bellows Breath deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid relying on health alone.
Ornn.combo: Your standard poke is Sion E Roar of the Slayer → Sion Q Decimating Smash. Before engaging, activate Sion W Soul Furnace's shield, then chain Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught's collision → Sion Q Decimating Smash → Sion W Soul Furnace's explosion → Sion E Roar of the Slayer. After the stun from R, charge Q only long enough to knock him up rather than waiting for a full charge, so you can land it reliably.
Ornn.escape: Don't rush in when only Ornn E Searing Charge is down, since Ornn can escape with Ornn R Call of the Forge God. The window before Ornn R Call of the Forge God is back up is especially good for closing the distance with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. When Ornn W Bellows Breath makes you Brittle, don't move forward; wait for the effect to end.
Ornn.fight: For a trade, slow Ornn and reduce his armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then hit him with Sion Q Decimating Smash. If Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God is still available, don't force an engage even if you dodged one of them. Look for a chance to close the distance with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught before Ornn R Call of the Forge God is back up.
Ornn.laning: Early on, prioritize safe last hits and stacking maximum health with Sion W Soul Furnace over getting kills. Push a minion toward Ornn with Sion E Roar of the Slayer to slow him, then look for Sion Q Decimating Smash. If Ornn tries to craft an item in lane, stay close and attack to interrupt him.
Ornn.phase: Sion gets strong in the mid-to-late game when the maximum health stacked with Sion W Soul Furnace combines with defensive items, but you also need to apply pressure before Ornn’s items and his allies’ Masterwork upgrades accumulate.
Ornn.teamfight: Move out of the straight line between Ornn and the elemental from Ornn R Call of the Forge God, and also avoid the redirected path after the elemental passes. When your allies can follow up, engage with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught from outside vision. On the frontline, reduce enemy armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, lock enemies down with Sion Q Decimating Smash and Sion W Soul Furnace, and guard the space in front of your allied damage dealers.
Ornn.watch: Stay away from the pillar left by Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and from nearby walls. Ornn E Searing Charge knocks you up if it hits terrain, so move toward open ground when Ornn prepares to charge. Keep your distance when Ornn W Bellows Breath makes you Brittle to avoid its bonus damage and long crowd control.

Pantheon.build: Build armor first because Pantheon's main damage is physical. However, Pantheon R Grand Starfall's penetration means some of your armor is ignored even if you build a lot of it, and Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on your maximum health. Reduce Pantheon's armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then deal physical damage.
Pantheon.combo: Your standard poke is to slow Pantheon and reduce his armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then hit him with Sion Q Decimating Smash. Before engaging, activate Sion W Soul Furnace; after the collision stun from Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught, charge Sion Q Decimating Smash only long enough to knock him up and land it. Then detonate Sion W Soul Furnace and use Sion E Roar of the Slayer, but wait to use damage abilities while Pantheon E Aegis Assault is blocking from the front.
Pantheon.escape: Don't engage as soon as Pantheon W Shield Vault is down. If Pantheon R Grand Starfall is also down and won't be back yet, look for a chance to close the distance with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught and lock him down with Sion Q Decimating Smash.
Pantheon.fight: Avoid trading blows early. From outside Pantheon W Shield Vault's range, slow him with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and then land Sion Q Decimating Smash. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is blocking from the front, delay your attacks or angle in from the side. While charging Sion Q Decimating Smash, watch whether Pantheon can escape; when you are in an exposed position, charge only long enough to knock him up, then release it.
Pantheon.laning: Keep minions between you and Pantheon to reduce Pantheon Q Comet Spear poke, then use Sion E Roar of the Slayer to push a minion toward him and look for an angle to hit him. Use Sion W Soul Furnace to absorb damage while stacking maximum health from unit kills.
Pantheon.phase: In the mid-to-late game, Sion's stacked maximum health from Sion W Soul Furnace combines with defensive items while Pantheon's influence falls off, so reduce your early losses and then look for teamfights.
Pantheon.teamfight: Start Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught from where the enemy can't see you when your allies can follow up. On the frontline, reduce Pantheon's armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, lock down enemies with Sion Q Decimating Smash and Sion W Soul Furnace, and protect your allied damage dealers. If you see the landing warning for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of its landing area.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault stuns a targeted enemy, so stay out of its range. Take Pantheon Q Comet Spear poke with minions between you. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active, don't use abilities from the front; wait for it to end.

Poppy.build: Build armor first against the main physical damage from Poppy Q Hammer Shock, Poppy E Heroic Charge, and Poppy R Keeper's Verdict. Even though Sion W Soul Furnace increases your maximum health, avoid relying on health alone because Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your maximum health. Don't spend extra resources on magic resistance just to deal with Poppy.
Poppy.combo: Your standard poke is to slow Poppy with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then land Sion Q Decimating Smash. When Poppy E Heroic Charge is down and Poppy W Steadfast Presence has ended, activate Sion W Soul Furnace beforehand, then collide with her using Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. Then charge Sion Q Decimating Smash only long enough to knock her up and land it, detonate Sion W Soul Furnace, and use Sion E Roar of the Slayer.
Poppy.escape: The moment after Poppy E Heroic Charge is down is a chance to close the distance. If Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, wait for it to end, then engage with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. After the collision, land Sion Q Decimating Smash reliably rather than trying to charge it for a long time.
Poppy.fight: In lane, push a minion toward Poppy with Sion E Roar of the Slayer to slow her, then land Sion Q Decimating Smash. Charge Sion Q Decimating Smash only long enough to knock her up, then release it before she can escape. If Poppy E Heroic Charge is down and Poppy W Steadfast Presence has ended, close the distance with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught.
Poppy.laning: Early on, prioritize safe farming and stacking maximum health with Sion W Soul Furnace over getting kills. Avoid standing with a wall behind you to dodge the stun from Poppy E Heroic Charge, and step on Poppy P Iron Ambassador's shield when it drops to prevent her from getting the shield. Poke by pushing a minion toward Poppy with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, and charge Sion Q Decimating Smash when you can land it.
Poppy.phase: In the mid-to-late game, use your stacked maximum health and defensive items to frontline, while continuing to dodge the damage based on maximum health from Poppy Q Hammer Shock.
Poppy.teamfight: Choose a straight path outside vision within follow-up range of your allies, then engage with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. On the frontline, reduce enemy armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and lock them down with Sion Q Decimating Smash and Sion W Soul Furnace. If you see Poppy charging Poppy R Keeper's Verdict, move out of the area directly in front of her and hold a position where you can stand in front of your allied damage dealers to protect them.
Poppy.watch: Poppy E Heroic Charge stuns you if it pushes you into a wall, so stand in open space with no wall behind you. If you get hit by the first strike of Poppy Q Hammer Shock, immediately walk out of the remaining zone. Don't engage with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught while Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, and dodge Poppy R Keeper's Verdict to the side when she charges it.

Quinn.build: Buy armor items first and build armor. Quinn's main damage is physical, so there's no reason to build magic resistance first against her.
Quinn.combo: In lane, slow Quinn with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then charge and land Sion Q Decimating Smash. When engaging after Quinn E Vault is down, activate Sion W Soul Furnace beforehand, then use Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught's collision → Sion Q Decimating Smash → Sion W Soul Furnace's explosion → Sion E Roar of the Slayer. During the stun from R, don't try to fully charge Q; charge only long enough to knock her up and land it reliably.
Quinn.escape: The moment after Quinn E Vault is down is your window to engage. Wait until then, since Quinn can knock away an approaching Sion and retreat while E is available. After she uses E, close the distance with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught and look for Sion Q Decimating Smash.
Quinn.fight: Don't approach first while Quinn E Vault is still available. Once it is down, slow her with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and land Sion Q Decimating Smash, or close the distance with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught.
Quinn.laning: Early on, Quinn outranges you, so preserve your health while farming and stacking maximum health with Sion W Soul Furnace. Push minions and look for an angle to hit Quinn with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, but back off and let Quinn P Harrier's mark expire when it appears.
Quinn.phase: In the early laning phase, focus on surviving and farming against Quinn's range advantage. In the mid-to-late game, join teamfights using the maximum health stacked with Sion W Soul Furnace and your defensive items.
Quinn.teamfight: Reduce enemy armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, lock them down with Sion Q Decimating Smash, and guard the space in front of your allied damage dealers. If Quinn comes in from the flank, catch her with crowd control. Start Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught from outside vision when your allies can follow up.
Quinn.watch: When Quinn P Harrier marks you, step outside basic attack range to avoid her empowered attack. Stand behind minions to dodge the first hit of Quinn Q Blinding Assault, and don't force an approach while Quinn E Vault is still available.

Renekton.build: Build armor first against Renekton's main ability damage. If Renekton is sustaining through the healing from Q Cull the Meek, buy Thornmail earlier to keep Grievous Wounds active. The second cast of empowered Renekton E Slice and Dice reduces your armor, so first position yourself where you can dodge that dash.
Renekton.combo: If Renekton E Slice and Dice is down, slow him with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then charge Sion Q Decimating Smash long enough to knock him up and land it. When engaging with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught, follow the collision stun with Sion Q Decimating Smash, Sion W Soul Furnace's explosion, then Sion E Roar of the Slayer. If Renekton has enough Fury to use empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator, don't rely on Sion W Soul Furnace's shield to withstand an engage combo.
Renekton.escape: Engage right after Renekton uses Renekton E Slice and Dice to escape and his mobility is down. If Renekton W Ruthless Predator is also down, you can close the distance with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught without worrying about its stun. Follow up with the slow from Sion E Roar of the Slayer and Sion Q Decimating Smash.
Renekton.fight: Look for trades when Renekton is out of Fury. You can also retaliate right after he uses Renekton Q Cull the Meek, Renekton W Ruthless Predator, and Renekton E Slice and Dice.
Renekton.laning: Early on, prioritize safe farming and stacking maximum health with Sion W Soul Furnace over getting kills. Poke Renekton by pushing a minion toward him with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, and use Sion Q Decimating Smash when Renekton's movement is limited. Look for chances to poke when Renekton steps toward minions to build Fury.
Renekton.phase: Renekton's value falls off after the midgame, while Sion gets strong in the mid-to-late game when the health stacked with Sion W Soul Furnace combines with defensive items.
Renekton.teamfight: Engage with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught from outside vision when your allies can follow up. On the frontline, reduce enemy armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and lock enemies down with Sion Q Decimating Smash's area stun and Sion W Soul Furnace's explosion. Protect your allied damage dealers, and after you fall, use Sion P Glory in Death to buy your allies time to retreat.
Renekton.watch: When Renekton P Reign of Anger is around or above half full, watch out for empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator and stay out of range. Empowered W breaks Sion W Soul Furnace's shield first, so don't rely on the shield to absorb the stun. Renekton E Slice and Dice unlocks a second dash if it hits a minion, so avoid standing in or behind a group of minions.

Riven.build: All of Riven's damage is physical, so build armor first. If Riven starts getting ahead, prioritize defensive items sooner and get health as well to guard against the execute damage from Riven R Blade of the Exile.
Riven.combo: Your standard poke is to slow Riven with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then land Sion Q Decimating Smash. When Riven's mobility is down and you engage, activate Sion W Soul Furnace's shield beforehand, then chain Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught's collision stun → Sion Q Decimating Smash → Sion W Soul Furnace's explosion → Sion E Roar of the Slayer. Charge Sion Q Decimating Smash only long enough to knock her up and land it reliably rather than waiting for a full charge.
Riven.escape: Don't engage just because Riven E Valor is down; look for an opening after Riven Q Broken Wings is also exhausted. Then close the distance with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught and follow with Sion Q Decimating Smash. If Riven W Ki Burst or the third cast of Riven Q Broken Wings is still available, be aware that it can interrupt Sion Q Decimating Smash's charge.
Riven.fight: Look for trades after Riven Q Broken Wings has been used to clear minions or is otherwise down. If Riven approaches, absorb damage with Sion W Soul Furnace's shield and use Sion Q Decimating Smash to interrupt her remaining combo.
Riven.laning: Early on, prioritize safe farming and stacking maximum health with Sion W Soul Furnace over getting kills. Poke Riven by pushing a minion toward her with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, and don't charge Sion Q Decimating Smash too early while Riven's mobility is available.
Riven.phase: Early on, safe farming is more important for Sion than applying pressure, and avoid forced fights while Riven is holding her abilities.
Riven.teamfight: On the frontline, reduce enemy armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and lock enemies down with Sion Q Decimating Smash and Sion W Soul Furnace. Start Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught from where the enemy can't see you when your allies can follow up. If Riven is on you, charge Sion Q Decimating Smash after the third cast of Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven W Ki Burst are down.
Riven.watch: When both Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor are available, watch out for chained dashes and move back when you see the first one. When Riven R Blade of the Exile is active, her range increases and her finishing damage based on missing health becomes dangerous, so keep your distance until it ends.

Rumble.build: Most of Rumble's damage is magic, so prioritize Spirit Visage among defensive items with magic resistance. Spirit Visage also helps Sion W Soul Furnace's shield and the lifesteal during your revival. Rumble P Junkyard Titan and Rumble Q Flamespitter deal damage based on your maximum health, so avoid relying on health alone.
Rumble.combo: Your standard poke is to slow Rumble with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then land Sion Q Decimating Smash. When engaging, activate Sion W Soul Furnace's shield beforehand and collide with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught, then charge Sion Q Decimating Smash only long enough to knock Rumble up and land it. After the enemies gather, detonate Sion W Soul Furnace and use Sion E Roar of the Slayer.
Rumble.escape: Rumble has no mobility ability to create distance on his own, so your chance to engage comes after he has also used Rumble W Scrap Shield.
Rumble.fight: Keep enough distance that Rumble has to walk forward to start a trade, and don't stay in Rumble Q Flamespitter for long. If Rumble activates Rumble W Scrap Shield, wait briefly for the shield to disappear before attacking. When you get a chance to catch him, close the distance with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught and land Sion Q Decimating Smash.
Rumble.laning: Early on, focus on safe farming and stacking maximum health with Sion W Soul Furnace over getting kills. Use Sion E Roar of the Slayer on a minion to push it into Rumble, and use Sion Q Decimating Smash when he is slowed. If you get hit by the first cast of Rumble E Electro Harpoon, create distance immediately instead of standing there.
Rumble.teamfight: Start Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught on a straight path outside vision when your allies can follow up. On the frontline, reduce enemy armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and lock down multiple enemies with Sion Q Decimating Smash to protect your allied damage dealers. Use Sion W Soul Furnace's shield, and if you fall near an objective, continue your final actions with Sion P Glory in Death.
Rumble.watch: Watch for the first cast of Rumble E Electro Harpoon. If both casts hit in a row, the slow becomes much stronger and your magic resistance is reduced, so immediately create distance after the first hit to dodge the second. Rumble Q Flamespitter deals damage based on your maximum health, so minimize the time Rumble stays close to you.

Sett.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Sett P Pit Grit and Sett Q Knuckle Down. Also consider attack speed reduction to reduce damage that depends on basic attacks and attack speed. Sett Q Knuckle Down deals damage based on your maximum health and the center of Sett W Haymaker deals true damage, so don't rely on stacking health alone.
Sett.combo: Your standard poke is to slow the enemy with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then charge and land Sion Q Decimating Smash. When engaging, activate Sion W Soul Furnace beforehand and follow the collision stun from Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught with Sion Q Decimating Smash, charged only long enough to knock the enemy up. After the enemies gather, detonate Sion W Soul Furnace and follow with Sion E Roar of the Slayer.
Sett.escape: If Sett E Facebreaker is also down, close the distance with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught and follow with Sion Q Decimating Smash.
Sett.fight: Slow the enemy and reduce their armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then land Sion Q Decimating Smash. If the enemy can move, release Sion Q Decimating Smash after charging only long enough to knock them up. After dealing damage, watch for the moment Sett W Haymaker becomes stronger and create distance, then approach again once his Grit has faded.
