Sett.laning: Early on, prioritize safe farming and stacking maximum health with Sion W Soul Furnace over getting kills. Poke Sett by pushing a minion toward him with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, and use Sion Q Decimating Smash when he is slowed. Avoid positions where you are on the opposite side of Sett from a minion group, so Sett E Facebreaker can't stun you.
Sett.phase: In the mid-to-late game, use the power spike from your maximum health stacked with Sion W Soul Furnace and your defensive items.
Sett.teamfight: Start Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught from where the enemy can't see you when your allies can follow up. On the frontline, reduce enemy armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and lock enemies down with Sion Q Decimating Smash's area stun and Sion W Soul Furnace's explosion. Watch your position so Sett R The Show Stopper can't grab you and throw you toward your allies; after you fall, use Sion P Glory in Death to buy your allies time to retreat or keep fighting near an objective.
Sett.watch: Sett W Haymaker gets stronger right after Sett has taken a lot of damage, so create distance after dealing heavy damage and step to the side of the center indicator. Sett E Facebreaker stuns when there is an enemy on each side of Sett, so don't get caught between a minion group and Sett. Sett R The Show Stopper is dangerous to frontliners who have built bonus health like Sion, so avoid positions where Sett can throw you at your allies while his ultimate is available.

Shen.build: Shen E Shadow Dash deals physical damage, while Shen Q Twilight Assault deals magic damage, so don’t build only one type of resistance; prioritize tenacity. Shen Q Twilight Assault deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking only health.
Shen.combo: For a basic trade, use Sion E Roar of the Slayer → Sion Q Decimating Smash. Before engaging, activate Sion W Soul Furnace. After the stun from Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught, charge Sion Q Decimating Smash just long enough to knock Shen up, then detonate Sion W Soul Furnace and use Sion E Roar of the Slayer.
Shen.escape: Engage as soon as Shen E Shadow Dash misses and his taunt and mobility are down. If Shen R Stand United is also not back up yet, close the distance with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught and follow with Sion Q Decimating Smash.
Shen.fight: Counterattack as soon as Shen E Shadow Dash misses. First use Sion E Roar of the Slayer to slow Shen and reduce his armor, then hit him with Sion Q Decimating Smash. Shen W Spirit's Refuge blocks basic attacks but not abilities, so follow up with your abilities.
Shen.laning: Early on, prioritize safe last hits and stacking maximum health with Sion W Soul Furnace over trying to get kills. Hit minions with Sion E Roar of the Slayer to push them toward Shen and poke him, and push the lane so Shen loses out when he uses Shen R Stand United to influence another lane.
Shen.phase: Even though Shen is weak in lane early, Sion also has a hard time getting kills, so focus on farming and lane control. In the mid to late game, use the maximum health stacked with Sion W Soul Furnace and your defensive items to serve as the frontline.
Shen.teamfight: Tell your team immediately if Shen disappears or you see Shen R Stand United channeling, then judge whether you can finish the fight before he arrives. In teamfights, engage with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught from out of vision when your allies can follow up. From the frontline, reduce armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and lock enemies down with Sion Q Decimating Smash and Sion W Soul Furnace.
Shen.watch: If Shen E Shadow Dash taunts you, you will be hit by attacks empowered by Shen Q Twilight Assault, so dodge the dash path. Also move out of the path of the spirit blade returning to Shen to reduce the damage from Shen Q Twilight Assault.

Singed.build: Build toward Spirit Visage as your first defensive item to increase magic resistance. Both Singed Q Poison Trail and Singed E Fling deal magic damage, and Spirit Visage also helps Sion W Soul Furnace’s shield. Singed E Fling deals damage based on maximum health, so prioritize magic resistance and movement speed to get out of the poison trail over stacking only health.
Singed.combo: For a basic trade, use Sion E Roar of the Slayer → Sion Q Decimating Smash. Before engaging, activate Sion W Soul Furnace for its shield, then chain Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught’s impact → Sion Q Decimating Smash → Sion E Roar of the Slayer. Charge Sion Q Decimating Smash just long enough to knock Singed up and hit reliably, and detonate Sion W Soul Furnace when he is close.
Singed.escape: Don’t engage with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught where Singed W Mega Adhesive is active. Avoid the adhesive, then, if an opening appears after Singed E Fling is down, close in with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught and keep Singed in place with Sion Q Decimating Smash. Singed has no ability to create distance on his own, so after catching him, you have an opportunity to force him to use Flash.
Singed.fight: In lane, make short trades by slowing Singed with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then hitting him with Sion Q Decimating Smash. If you’ve avoided Singed W Mega Adhesive and have an opening to engage, catch him with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. If Singed retreats while leaving Singed Q Poison Trail behind, stop chasing unless you have enough damage to finish him reliably.
Singed.laning: Sion also has little pressure at this stage, so prioritize safe last hits and stacking maximum health with Sion W Soul Furnace over forcing kills. Don’t walk through Singed Q Poison Trail, and poke to avoid being pushed out of lane.
Singed.phase: Once Singed has his core items, he becomes difficult to catch, so don’t fixate on chasing him. In the mid to late game, use the maximum health stacked with Sion W Soul Furnace and your defensive items to serve as the frontline.
Singed.teamfight: Instead of chasing Singed to the end, hold him in place with Sion Q Decimating Smash or Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught while your allies attack his team. Reduce armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, detonate Sion W Soul Furnace, and block for your allied damage dealers. Start Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught from out of vision when your allies can follow up.
Singed.watch: Don’t chase a low-health Singed through Singed Q Poison Trail. You can’t move through Singed W Mega Adhesive with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught, so go around it. Singed E Fling throws you behind him, so don’t stand in front of Singed when he has his back to your team.

Skarner.build: First decide whether you need Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar to counter the suppression from Skarner R Impale. For resistances, prioritize magic resistance to account for damage from Skarner P Threads of Vibration, Skarner W Seismic Bastion, and Skarner R Impale. Since he deals damage based on maximum health, consider movement speed to get out of telegraphed areas instead of stacking only health.
Skarner.combo: For a basic trade, slow Skarner with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then hit him with Sion Q Decimating Smash. To engage after Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, activate Sion W Soul Furnace first, then, after the stun from Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught’s impact, charge Sion Q Decimating Smash just long enough to knock him up and hit him. Once enemies are grouped, detonate Sion W Soul Furnace and reduce their armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer.
Skarner.escape: The opening to engage is right after you bait out Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. At that moment, close the gap with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught and follow up with Sion Q Decimating Smash. If you have allowed a wall collision from Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, account for re-engagement and back off first.
Skarner.fight: While Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is available, fight away from walls and take short trades while absorbing damage with Sion W Soul Furnace’s shield. Right after Skarner uses E Ixtal's Impact, close the gap with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught and hit him with Sion Q Decimating Smash. If Skarner isn’t already held in place, release Sion Q Decimating Smash after charging only long enough to knock him up.
Skarner.laning: Early on, focus on safe farming and stacking maximum health with Sion W Soul Furnace over kills. Push minions with Sion E Roar of the Slayer to slow Skarner, then poke him with Sion Q Decimating Smash. Stay away from walls so Skarner E Ixtal's Impact can’t stun you against one.
Skarner.phase: Sion gets stronger in the mid to late game with stacked maximum health and defensive items, but Skarner’s damage also increases with tank items, so don’t give him an easy chance to scale.
Skarner.teamfight: Avoid walls and the edges of objective pits, and watch out for the stun from Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and the pull from Skarner R Impale. Engage with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught from out of vision when your allies can follow up. From the frontline, reduce armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and lock enemies down with Sion Q Decimating Smash and Sion W Soul Furnace to protect your allied damage dealers.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact can pass through terrain, and if you are caught and then collide with a wall, you’ll be stunned, so don’t stand with your back to a wall. The more hits you take at close range from Skarner Q Shattered Earth / Upheaval empowered basic attacks and Skarner P Threads of Vibration, the more dangerous they become, so don’t let him remain in melee range for long. Skarner R Impale is a suppression that can’t be interrupted by a stun, so position yourself before entering its range.

TahmKench.build: Tahm Kench’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first, and consider Spirit Visage as a defensive item. Spirit Visage is also valuable for Sion W Soul Furnace’s shield and life steal during your revival. If you expect frequent extended duels, get Executioner's Calling early for Sion, who mainly deals physical damage, and consider penetration to counter Tahm Kench’s high armor.
TahmKench.combo: For a basic trade, use Sion E Roar of the Slayer → Sion Q Decimating Smash. Before engaging, activate Sion W Soul Furnace, then chain Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught’s impact → Sion Q Decimating Smash → Sion W Soul Furnace detonation → Sion E Roar of the Slayer. Don’t insist on fully charging Sion Q Decimating Smash; charge it just long enough to knock Tahm Kench up and hit him reliably.
TahmKench.escape: When Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is down, he has a harder time engaging and escaping, so that’s your chance to go in with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. If you have stacks from Tahm Kench’s basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash, first create distance and wait for the stacks to disappear before engaging.
TahmKench.fight: Tahm Kench E Thick Skin converts damage taken into a shield or healing, so avoid trades where you hit him a little and back off. When you have no stacks from Tahm Kench and Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is down, slow him and reduce his armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then hit him with Sion Q Decimating Smash.
TahmKench.laning: Early on, prioritize safe farming and stacking maximum health with Sion W Soul Furnace over kills. Use Sion E Roar of the Slayer on minions to push them toward Tahm Kench and poke him, and use Sion Q Decimating Smash when you have a clear opening to hit him. If Tahm Kench has two stacks on you, back off and avoid taking another hit.
TahmKench.phase: If you fall far behind early, you lack the damage to turn things around alone, so avoid forcing fights.
TahmKench.teamfight: If you see Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, spread out from your allies. If Tahm Kench R Devour is available, account for the possibility that he can swallow the enemy he is protecting. Start Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught from out of sight when your allies can follow up, then reduce armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and hold enemies in place with Sion Q Decimating Smash. If an ally is swallowed, focus your damage on Tahm Kench.
TahmKench.watch: After three hits from Tahm Kench’s basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash, he has openings to stun you and use Tahm Kench R Devour. If you think you have two stacks, move out of range and wait for them to disappear. If you see the animation for Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, spread out from your allies to avoid the area knock-up.

Teemo.build: Teemo’s main damage from Q Blinding Dart, E Toxic Shot, and R Noxious Trap is magic, so build magic resistance first. Consider Spirit Visage as a defensive item. Its increased healing and shielding helps both Sion W Soul Furnace’s shield and the life steal during Sion P Glory in Death.
Teemo.combo: For a basic trade, slow Teemo with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then use Sion Q Decimating Smash. Before engaging, activate Sion W Soul Furnace for its shield. After the stun from Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught’s impact, charge Sion Q Decimating Smash just long enough to knock Teemo up and hit him. Then detonate Sion W Soul Furnace and use Sion E Roar of the Slayer.
Teemo.escape: A good window to engage is right after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down. If Teemo W Move Quick is already used, close the gap with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught and follow with Sion Q Decimating Smash.
Teemo.fight: Early on, avoid short trades where you take poison damage from Teemo E Toxic Shot and then back away. Look to trade as soon as Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down: slow him with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then hit him with Sion Q Decimating Smash. If you commit to an engage, close the gap in one go before Teemo W Move Quick creates distance.
Teemo.laning: Early on, prioritize safe farming and stacking maximum health with Sion W Soul Furnace over kills. Use Sion E Roar of the Slayer on minions to push them toward Teemo and poke him, and use Sion Q Decimating Smash when Teemo is slowed. To watch for Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare in brush where you have no vision, go around it or check with a Control Ward.
Teemo.phase: Sion gets strong in the mid to late game when the maximum health stacked with Sion W Soul Furnace combines with defensive items, but if you give Teemo time, he’ll fill pathways with Teemo R Noxious Trap.
Teemo.teamfight: Use Oracle Lens to clear Teemo R Noxious Trap around objectives and in narrow paths. Start Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught from out of vision when your allies can follow up. After engaging, reduce armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, keep enemies occupied with Sion Q Decimating Smash and Sion W Soul Furnace, and block for your allied damage dealers.
Teemo.watch: If you’re hit by Teemo Q Blinding Dart, your basic attacks are negated, so use abilities instead of basic attacks or back off. A single hit from Teemo E Toxic Shot applies ongoing poison damage, so stay out of range unless you’re ready to engage. Watch out for hidden Teemo R Noxious Trap around objectives and in narrow paths.

Trundle.build: Build armor first against Trundle Q Chomp and his basic attacks. Trundle R Subjugate deals damage based on maximum health and steals resistances, so consider defensive options that reduce attack speed instead of continuing to stack only health or resistances.
Trundle.combo: For a basic trade, slow Trundle with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then hit him with Sion Q Decimating Smash. Before engaging, activate Sion W Soul Furnace, then collide with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught and charge Sion Q Decimating Smash just long enough to knock him up and hit him. Then detonate Sion W Soul Furnace and use Sion E Roar of the Slayer.
Trundle.escape: Look to engage after Trundle E Pillar of Ice is down and after leaving Trundle W Frozen Domain. Trundle has no ability to create distance on his own, so close in with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught and hold him in place with Sion Q Decimating Smash. If Trundle R Subjugate is active, create distance first.
Trundle.fight: Avoid trading inside Trundle W Frozen Domain and back away out of it. When you fight, slow him with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and hit him with Sion Q Decimating Smash, charging only long enough to knock him up unless he is already held in place. Create distance while Trundle R Subjugate is active, and don’t face him alone for long.
Trundle.laning: Early on, prioritize safe farming and stacking maximum health with Sion W Soul Furnace over kills. Push minions toward Trundle with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and hit him with it, then poke with Sion Q Decimating Smash only while he is slowed. Trundle P King's Tribute heals him whenever a nearby unit dies, so don’t drag out lane by chipping away at his health; after a successful poke, secure your advantage or push the lane to force him to recall.
Trundle.teamfight: Start Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught from out of vision and enter the enemy backline when your allies can follow up. From the frontline, reduce armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and keep enemies occupied with Sion Q Decimating Smash and Sion W Soul Furnace to protect your allied damage dealers. While hit by Trundle R Subjugate, target someone else or create distance instead of attacking Trundle, and watch out for Trundle E Pillar of Ice blocking your escape route in narrow paths.
Trundle.watch: Trundle gains attack speed and healing on Trundle W Frozen Domain, so don’t fight inside it; back away and wait out its duration. Trundle E Pillar of Ice blocks escape routes in narrow paths, so fight in open areas and move sideways as soon as the pillar appears. Trundle R Subjugate deals damage based on Sion’s maximum health and steals resistances, so if it hits you, create distance and don’t focus Trundle while it lasts.

Tryndamere.build: Tryndamere’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Get Thornmail early to counter his healing and basic attacks.
Tryndamere.combo: For a basic trade, use Sion E Roar of the Slayer → Sion Q Decimating Smash. To engage after Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down, activate Sion W Soul Furnace first, then, after the stun from Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught’s impact, charge Sion Q Decimating Smash just long enough to knock him up and hit him. Then detonate the shield and use Sion E Roar of the Slayer.
Tryndamere.escape: The opening to engage is right after you bait out Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. Close the gap with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught on terrain without minions, then hold him in place with Sion Q Decimating Smash.
Tryndamere.fight: Look for an opening right after Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down: slow him with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and hit him with Sion Q Decimating Smash. If Tryndamere W Mocking Shout hits you, avoid a basic attack fight. When backing away, walk backward while facing Tryndamere.
Tryndamere.laning: Early on, prioritize safe last hits and stacking maximum health with Sion W Soul Furnace over kills. Use Sion E Roar of the Slayer on minions to push them toward Tryndamere and poke him. If Tryndamere starts building Fury by hitting minions, create distance before closing in.
Tryndamere.phase: Early on, Sion has little pressure while Tryndamere can build Fury to use critical strikes and healing, so focus on safe farming. In the mid to late game, use the maximum health stacked with Sion W Soul Furnace and your defensive items to serve as the frontline.
Tryndamere.teamfight: Start Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught from fog of war or behind a wall when your allies can follow up. From the frontline, reduce armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and hold enemies in place with Sion Q Decimating Smash to protect your allied damage dealers. If Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, let time run out with crowd control instead of focusing damage, and don’t face a Tryndamere with R ready alone in a side lane.
Tryndamere.watch: Tryndamere P Battle Fury’s critical strikes and Tryndamere Q Bloodlust’s healing become more threatening as his Fury builds, so create distance if he builds Fury by hitting minions. Tryndamere E Spinning Slash comes back quickly after a critical strike, so don’t chase him where there are lots of minions. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, let time run out with Sion Q Decimating Smash or Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught instead of pouring in damage.

Udyr.build: Build armor first to withstand Udyr’s main damage. Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals both physical and magic damage, while Udyr R Wingborne Storm deals magic damage, so armor alone won’t block everything. If most of the enemy’s damage is magic, consider Spirit Visage, which also helps Sion W Soul Furnace’s shield.
Udyr.combo: For a basic trade, slow with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then hit with Sion Q Decimating Smash. Before engaging, activate Sion W Soul Furnace. After the impact stun from Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught, charge Sion Q Decimating Smash as much as needed and hit him. Then detonate Sion W Soul Furnace and use Sion E Roar of the Slayer to slow and reduce his armor.
Udyr.escape: Right after you make Udyr use Udyr E Blazing Stampede is a chance to close the distance with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. If Udyr E Blazing Stampede stuns you once, counterattack or escape while it can’t immediately stun the same target again. If he is Awakened, immobilizing effects don’t work, so use Sion Q Decimating Smash after that state ends.
Udyr.fight: Press your attack after Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield is gone, giving him no time to heal. Slow him with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then charge Sion Q Decimating Smash just long enough to knock him up and hit him. Don’t rely on Sion Q Decimating Smash’s immobilizing effect to fight before Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s Awakened state ends.
Udyr.laning: Early on, prioritize safe last hits and stacking maximum health with Sion W Soul Furnace over kills. Don’t push forward when Udyr is missing; watch for ganks with vision at the jungle entrance and key paths. Hit a minion with Sion E Roar of the Slayer to push it toward Udyr and poke him, and use Sion Q Decimating Smash when you have a chance to hit.
Udyr.phase: In the mid to late game, Sion becomes stronger as the maximum health stacked with Sion W Soul Furnace combines with defensive items.
Udyr.teamfight: Don’t force a kill on Udyr when he has defensive items and Udyr W Iron Mantle; target weaker enemies behind him first. Reduce armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, lock down enemies with Sion Q Decimating Smash, and protect your allied damage dealers from the front. Start Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught from out of sight when your team can follow up.
Udyr.watch: Udyr E Blazing Stampede closes distance quickly and stuns, so keep your distance right after Udyr activates it. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on your maximum health, so don’t stand and fight for long even if you’ve stacked health. During Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s Awakened state, immobilizing effects don’t work, so save Sion Q Decimating Smash.

Urgot.build: Urgot’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Urgot P Echoing Flames deals damage based on maximum health, so don’t focus only on stacking health. Sion’s physical damage is easily blocked by Urgot’s high armor, so consider penetration to increase your damage.
Urgot.combo: For a basic trade, use Sion E Roar of the Slayer → Sion Q Decimating Smash. To engage after Urgot E Disdain is down, activate Sion W Soul Furnace first, then collide with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught and charge Sion Q Decimating Smash just long enough to knock Urgot up and hit him. Then detonate Sion W Soul Furnace and reduce his armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer.
Urgot.escape: Urgot E Disdain is his only mobility tool, so the opening to engage with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught is right after you bait it out. If you’re slowed by Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and focused by his fire, escape with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught.
Urgot.fight: Don’t fight Urgot head-on for long while Urgot E Disdain is available. Right after he uses Urgot E Disdain, slow him and reduce his armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then hit him with Sion Q Decimating Smash. If he approaches with Urgot W Purge active, don’t rely only on slows; walk out of firing range.
Urgot.laning: Early on, focus on safe last hits and stacking maximum health with Sion W Soul Furnace over kills. Push minions toward Urgot with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and poke him. Use Sion Q Decimating Smash when Urgot E Disdain is down or he is held in place. Avoid trades where you stay near Urgot long enough to be hit by his leg cannons multiple times.
Urgot.phase: In the mid to late game, make use of the power spike when the maximum health stacked with Sion W Soul Furnace combines with defensive items.
Urgot.teamfight: From the frontline, block Urgot E Disdain’s engage, reduce armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then keep enemies occupied with Sion Q Decimating Smash and Sion W Soul Furnace. Start Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught from a straight path out of vision when your allies can follow up. Watch out for the execution from Urgot R Fear Beyond Death and hold your position in front of your allied damage dealers.
Urgot.watch: Urgot P Echoing Flames deals damage based on maximum health, so staying close to him for long is dangerous. If you’re hit by Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, you’ll be heavily slowed and focused by Urgot W Purge, so dodge it as it comes or decide whether to escape with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits you, get out of range before you reach the execution threshold.

Volibear.build: Build armor first to withstand the damage from Volibear Q Thundering Smash, W Frenzied Maul, and R Stormbringer. Since basic attacks and attack speed are central to his damage, consider an item that reduces attack speed too. If healing from Volibear W Frenzied Maul is a problem, build an item that reduces healing.
Volibear.combo: For a basic trade, use a minion with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then follow with Sion Q Decimating Smash. Before engaging, activate Sion W Soul Furnace. After the stun from Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught, charge Sion Q Decimating Smash just long enough to knock Volibear up and hit him. Then detonate Sion W Soul Furnace and use Sion E Roar of the Slayer.
Volibear.escape: The opening to engage comes after both Volibear Q Thundering Smash and R Stormbringer are down; especially look for a chance before Volibear R Stormbringer comes back. Close the distance with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught and catch him with Sion Q Decimating Smash. If only Volibear Q Thundering Smash is down, he can escape with Volibear R Stormbringer, so don’t engage hastily.
Volibear.fight: Avoid fighting Volibear while his passive P The Relentless Storm is fully stacked; fight after the stacks fall off. Slow him with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then hit him with Sion Q Decimating Smash for a short trade. Even if Volibear’s health has decreased, if he can still heal with W Frenzied Maul, keep fighting only when you have a sure chance to finish him.
Volibear.laning: Early on, prioritize safe last hits and stacking maximum health with Sion W Soul Furnace over kills. Push a minion into Volibear with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then charge Sion Q Decimating Smash when he is slowed. If the mark from Volibear E Sky Splitter appears, don’t insist on charging; leave its area.
Volibear.phase: Sion has a hard time applying pressure with just one ability early on, so farm instead of forcing a fight with Volibear. In the mid to late game, Sion gets stronger as the maximum health stacked with Sion W Soul Furnace combines with defensive items.
Volibear.teamfight: If Volibear has stacked his passive P The Relentless Storm by attacking minions or monsters, don’t take a fight until the stacks fall off. From the front, Sion reduces armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and locks down enemies with Sion Q Decimating Smash to protect allied damage dealers. Start Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught from out of the enemy’s sight when your team can follow up. If Volibear R Stormbringer is available, watch out for a dive even under your turret.
Volibear.watch: When Volibear activates Volibear Q Thundering Smash and runs at you, watch out for the stun on his empowered basic attack. Slow him with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and let time pass outside his basic attack range. When the mark from Volibear E Sky Splitter appears, move to the side to avoid its damage and slow. Volibear can heal with Volibear W Frenzied Maul, so don’t prolong the fight unless you can finish him off for sure.

Yasuo.build: Build armor first to withstand Yasuo’s main damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath. The magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade isn’t blocked by armor, and attack speed reduction also slows his basic attacks and the timing of his whirlwind.
Yasuo.combo: For a basic trade, slow with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then hit with Sion Q Decimating Smash. Before engaging, activate the shield from Sion W Soul Furnace, then chain these abilities: Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught’s impact stun → Sion Q Decimating Smash → Sion W Soul Furnace explosion → Sion E Roar of the Slayer. During the stun from Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught, don’t wait for Sion Q Decimating Smash to reach maximum charge; release it once it has charged enough to knock him up.
Yasuo.escape: Engage with crowd control right after Yasuo throws his whirlwind and before Yasuo R Last Breath comes back. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can be used often, so don’t engage just because it went down once. Close the distance with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught where there are few minions for him to dash through, then follow with Sion Q Decimating Smash.
Yasuo.fight: Use light poke to remove Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield first, then trade seriously after it disappears. Right after Yasuo throws his whirlwind, his knock-up stacks reset, so slow him with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and hit him with Sion Q Decimating Smash. If he still has a target to dash out through with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, charge Sion Q Decimating Smash only long enough to knock him up, and make sure it hits.
Yasuo.laning: Early on, prioritize safe last hits and stacking maximum health with Sion W Soul Furnace over kills. Keep the wave thin on your side to reduce the minions Yasuo can use to approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Look for an angle to push a minion into Yasuo with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, and use Sion Q Decimating Smash when he is slowed or immobilized.
Yasuo.phase: In the mid to late game, Sion is strongest when the maximum health stacked with Sion W Soul Furnace combines with defensive items, so focus on your frontline role.
Yasuo.teamfight: When your team can follow up, start Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught on a straight path from out of sight and aim for the enemy backline. After you die, use Sion P Glory in Death to fight once more in front of an objective or buy your allies time to retreat.
Yasuo.watch: The whirlwind after Yasuo hits twice with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knocks you up, so move sideways out of its line when you hear the stack sound and see the effect. Yasuo approaches by dashing through minions with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, so don’t charge Sion Q Decimating Smash for long where there are lots of minions. Yasuo W Wind Wall blocks projectiles, so save projectile-based poke that would pass behind the wall.

Yone.build: The information doesn’t specify a purchase order or item names, so it’s not possible to determine what to buy first. Yone deals both physical and magic damage, so build both armor and magic resistance, and consider attack speed reduction and movement speed as well.
Yone.combo: For a basic trade, slow with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then hit with Sion Q Decimating Smash. Save Sion Q Decimating Smash for when Yone comes in with Yone E Soul Unbound, then interrupt him with a knock-up or stun after he dives in, charging only as long as needed. If you engage with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught, activate Sion W Soul Furnace just beforehand. After the impact stun, make sure Sion Q Decimating Smash hits, then detonate the shield.
Yone.escape: Before Yone R Fate Sealed comes back is a chance to close the distance with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. But if Yone Q Mortal Steel or Yone E Soul Unbound is still available, don’t engage just because you dodged one of them. If Yone dives in first in his soul form, look for a chance to stop his return with the crowd control from Sion Q Decimating Smash.
Yone.fight: Don’t start a trade when Yone’s dash Q is ready. After he dives in with Yone E Soul Unbound, you can stop his return by landing the knock-up or stun from Sion Q Decimating Smash. Before engaging with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught, check whether Yone’s other mobility abilities are also down.
Yone.laning: Push a minion into Yone with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then charge Sion Q Decimating Smash once he is slowed. If Yone’s dash Q is ready, keep your distance and resume poking after the stacks disappear.
Yone.phase: In the mid to late game, Sion gets stronger when the maximum health stacked with Sion W Soul Furnace combines with defensive items, but stay wary of the damage based on maximum health from Yone W Spirit Cleave.
Yone.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Yone W Spirit Cleave doesn’t hit several of you and grant him a large shield. Yone R Fate Sealed sends him behind the last champion in its path, so before a team fight, make sure you aren’t standing alone at the very back. When your team can follow up, engage with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught from fog or behind a wall, reduce armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, then lock down enemies with Sion Q Decimating Smash.
Yone.watch: If Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions, he is preparing to dash in with a gust of wind, so stay out of range until the stacks disappear. When he comes in with Yone E Soul Unbound, he deals extra damage as he returns, so create distance early if your health is low. Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on your maximum health, so don’t rely on the health stacked with Sion W Soul Furnace to absorb it.

Yorick.build: Build armor first to withstand Yorick Q Last Rites and the Mist Walkers’ damage. Yorick E Mourning Mist and Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles deal damage based on maximum health, so don’t rely on building only health. If most of the enemy’s damage is magic, consider Spirit Visage, which also helps Sion W Soul Furnace’s shield.
Yorick.escape: Yorick has no mobility ability to create distance, so dodging Yorick E Mourning Mist and waiting until Yorick W Dark Procession is down creates an opening to engage. Close the distance with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught and catch him with Sion Q Decimating Smash.
Yorick.fight: Don’t start a fight where there are lots of graves and Mist Walkers; clear the Mist Walkers first. After dodging Yorick E Mourning Mist, step forward to farm or slow him with Sion E Roar of the Slayer and hit him with Sion Q Decimating Smash. If the Maiden of the Mist is alone in a side lane, it’s an opportunity to target Yorick himself.
Yorick.laning: Early on, prioritize safe last hits and stacking maximum health with Sion W Soul Furnace over kills. Push the lane so Yorick can’t build graves while clearing the wave on his side, and look for an angle to hit him by using Sion E Roar of the Slayer on a minion. If you dodge Yorick E Mourning Mist, step forward to farm until that ability is ready again.
Yorick.phase: In the mid to late game, Sion becomes stronger as the maximum health stacked with Sion W Soul Furnace combines with defensive items. Absorb Yorick’s side lane pressure, then look for a chance to join your main team.
Yorick.teamfight: When your team can follow up, start Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught from out of sight. From the front, reduce armor with Sion E Roar of the Slayer, lock down enemies with Sion Q Decimating Smash, then detonate Sion W Soul Furnace. Fight while protecting your allied damage dealers, and after you die, use Sion P Glory in Death to buy your allies time to retreat.
Yorick.watch: Yorick E Mourning Mist slows, marks, and deals damage based on your maximum health, so watch the orb’s trajectory and dodge it. If you get trapped by Yorick W Dark Procession, hit the wall to break it. If the Maiden of the Mist summoned by Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles starts attacking you, create distance from Yorick himself.
